description: This Java source file defines the PoliciesRoute class, which provides HTTP route handling logic for managing policies in the Eclipse Ditto gateway service. It constructs routes for operations like retrieving, updating, and deleting policies, as well as nested routes for policy entries.

classes.name: PoliciesRoute
classes.description: A route builder class for handling HTTP requests related to policies in the Eclipse Ditto gateway service. Extends AbstractRoute and provides endpoints for managing policies and their entries.

methods.name: buildPoliciesRoute
methods.description: Constructs and returns the route for the `/policies` endpoint, delegating requests to specific policies based on URL patterns.

methods.name: policyRoute
methods.description: Creates a route for a specific policy identified by policyId, including sub-routes for policy entry management.

methods.name: policyEntry
methods.description: Handles GET, PUT, and DELETE requests for a specific policy identified by policyId.

methods.name: createPolicyJsonObjectForPut
methods.description: Converts a JSON string payload into a JsonObject while ensuring the policy ID in the JSON matches the provided policyId.

methods.name: policyEntryEntries
methods.description: Creates the route for managing policy entries under a specific policy.
